basic_details.job_title: KV Karauli Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 2 Post Graduate Teacher, Special Educator Posts
basic_details.short_information: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Karauli is holding a walk-in interview on 28 November 2026 to form a panel of contractual teachers for the 2026-27 academic session. The two posts are Post Graduate Teacher – Economics (Snatakottar Shikshak-Arthshastra) at Rs.27500/- per month and Special Educator at Rs.21250/- per month. Candidates must register on the KVS Samvida Sathi portal (https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/) and attend document verification between 9 AM and 10 AM on the interview day.

how_to_apply: Register for the walk-in interview on the KVS Samvida Sathi portal: https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/.
Download the biodata form from the school website www.karauli.kvs.ac.in.
Report on 28.11.2026 for document verification between 9 AM and 10 AM (on the interview day only).
Present the filled biodata form at the time of the interview.
Biodata form downloaded from the school website
important_instructions: No post is reserved for any category (SC/ST/OBC/Ph/Women). Document verification is held only on the interview day, from 9 AM to 10 AM. Terms and conditions are as per KVS norms. Queries can be addressed to the school on 07464-297022 or [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About KV Karauli
content_sections.text: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Karauli is a Kendriya Vidyalaya located Behind Government College (Rajkiya Mahavidyalaya), Karauli (Raj.)-322241. Its remuneration and terms for contractual teachers follow the norms of the Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS). The school can be contacted on 07464-297022 or [email protected] , and its website is www.karauli.kvs.ac.in .

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The walk-in on 28.11.2026 is for the following two posts. The notice forms a panel and does not print the number of posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints the following essential and desirable qualifications for each post. (a) Integrated Post Graduate Course from NCTE recognized institution/University, in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks in aggregate including B.Ed. component, OR Master Degree from a recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks in aggregate in the concerned subject. AND (b) B.Ed. Degree from NCTE recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks, OR Three years Integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed. from NCTE recognized Institution/University with at least 50% marks, OR Four years Integrated Degree with at least 50% marks from NCTE recognized Institution/University including B.Ed. component. (c) Proficiency to Teach in Hindi and English medium. Master Degree subject for PGT (Economics): in the concerned subject or any specialization in the concerned subject, provided the candidate has studied the concerned subject at graduation level also. XII Passed with minimum 50% marks in aggregate. Any one of the special education qualifications listed below, from a recognized university/Institute. Qualified in Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) (Paper – 1) conducted by CBSE. Relaxation up to 5% in the qualifying marks shall be allowed to candidates belonging to reserved categories such as SC/ST/OBC/PwBD in CTET. Registration with Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) and having valid CRR number. Proficiency to teach in Hindi and English. Special education qualifications accepted (any one): Two-year D.Ed. Special Education in any of the category of disability One year Diploma in Special Education (DSE) in any of the category of disability Diploma in Community Based Rehabilitation (DCBR) with 6 months Certificate course in Education of Children with Special Needs Post Graduate Diploma in Community Based Rehabilitation (PGDCBR) with 6 months Certificate course in Education of Children with Special Needs Diploma in Multi Rehabilitation Worker (MRW) with 6 months Certificate Course in Education of Children with Special Needs Junior Diploma in Teaching the Deaf OR Primary level Teacher Training course in Visual Impairment Diploma in Vocational Rehabilitation-Mental Retardation (DVR-MR)/Diploma in Vocational Training and Employment-Mental Retardation (DVTE-MR) with 6 months Certificate course in Education of Children with Special Needs Diploma in Hearing Language and Speech (DHLS) with 6 months Certificate course in Education of Children with Special Needs XII passed with any RCI recognized qualification of minimum one year duration and 6 months Certificate course in Education of Children with Special Needs Any other equivalent qualification approved by RCI The eligibility annexure attached to the notice also lists qualifications for other Kendriya Vidyalaya contractual posts; for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification and the school website www.karauli.kvs.ac.in .

rows.essential_qualification: Master Degree (or NCTE-recognised integrated PG course) in Economics with at least 50% marks, plus B.Ed. or equivalent with at least 50% marks; proficiency to teach in Hindi and English. Full details below.
XII with minimum 50% marks, a special education qualification, CTET (Paper-1) and RCI registration with valid CRR number. Full details below.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice states that remuneration will be as per KVS Norms, and that consolidated payment on a monthly basis shall be made to the contractual teachers at Rs.27500/- per Month for PGT and Rs.21250/- per month for Special Educator. A teacher will not be entitled to pay for absence on a working day; in case of absence from duty, payment will be calculated on a pro rata basis. All appointments will be purely temporary and on contract, for the panel of the 2026-27 academic session. Teachers engaged on a contractual basis have no claim or right to appointment on a regular basis, will not be part of the cadre of teachers of Kendriya Vidyalaya, and are not entitled to Vacation, Autumn and Winter Break.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KV Karauli Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register for the walk-in interview on the KVS Samvida Sathi portal: https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/ . Download the biodata form from the school website www.karauli.kvs.ac.in . Report on 28.11.2026 for document verification between 9 AM and 10 AM (on the interview day only). Present the filled biodata form at the time of the interview. Documents named in the notice: Biodata form downloaded from the school website 01 passport size photo Attested copy of qualification certificates Original documents

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for KV Karauli contractual posts is through a walk-in interview on 28.11.2026, preceded by document verification from 9 AM to 10 AM on the same day. The notice does not state the venue separately from the school's name and address; the panel is being formed at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Karauli. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No post is reserved for any category (SC/ST/OBC/Ph/Women). Document verification is held only on the interview day, from 9 AM to 10 AM. Terms and conditions are as per KVS norms. Queries can be addressed to the school on 07464-297022 or [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. When is the KV Karauli walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for PGT (Economics) and Special Educator is on 28 November 2026, with document verification from 9 AM to 10 AM on that day.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are in the KV Karauli walk-in?
faq.answer: The walk-in is for Post Graduate Teacher (Economics) and Special Educator, to form a panel of contractual teachers for the 2026-27 session.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for PGT Economics at KV Karauli?
faq.answer: A Master Degree (or NCTE-recognised integrated PG course) in Economics with at least 50% marks, studied at graduation level also, plus B.Ed. or an equivalent integrated degree with at least 50% marks, and proficiency to teach in Hindi and English.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Special Educator at KV Karauli?
faq.answer: XII with minimum 50% marks, a listed or RCI-approved special education qualification, CTET (Paper-1), RCI registration with a valid CRR number, and proficiency to teach in Hindi and English.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for KV Karauli contractual teachers?
faq.answer: PGT gets Rs.27500/- per Month and Special Educator gets Rs.21250/- per month as a consolidated monthly payment, as per KVS norms.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the KV Karauli walk-in?
faq.answer: Register on https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/, download the biodata form from www.karauli.kvs.ac.in, and present it at the interview on 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the KV Karauli interview?
faq.answer: Bring the biodata form, 01 passport size photo, an attested copy of qualification certificates and original documents.

faq.question: Q8. Is the KV Karauli teacher job permanent?
faq.answer: No. All appointments are purely temporary and on contract, with no claim to regular appointment or to the Kendriya Vidyalaya teacher cadre.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a CTET relaxation for Special Educator?
faq.answer: Yes. Relaxation up to 5% in CTET qualifying marks is allowed to candidates from reserved categories such as SC/ST/OBC/PwBD.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the KV Karauli interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
